programme.title: Atelier Cuvelier / Atelier Cuvelier
programme.desc: What Michèle prefers to do is try to understand why something is brilliant. Why a book, a movie, a painting can touch her. She wants to unravel the secret of creation. So that's why she built a studio. Because that is the place where it happens, where your brain crackles and where the imagination rules. She fills her studio with the most beautiful makers in our country. They all take something from their own studio, open their heads for us and sprinkle extra star material in our lives. Welcome to Michèle Cuvelier's studio. / Wat Michèle het liefste doet is proberen te begrijpen waarom iets briljant is. Waarom een boek, een film, een schilderij haar kan raken. Ze wil het geheim van de schepping ontrafelen. Dus daarom heeft ze een atelier gebouwd. Want dat is de plek waar het gebeurt, waar je brein knettert en waar de verbeelding regeert. Ze vult haar atelier met de mooiste makers van ons land. Ze nemen allemaal iets mee uit hun eigen atelier, openen hun hoofden voor ons en strooien extra sterrenstof in ons leven. Welkom in het atelier van Michèle Cuvelier.

Drug gangs had the country completely in their grip and made El Salvador one of the most dangerous countries in the world. Until the current president, Nayib Bukele, came to power. Tom goes to El Salvador to discover if you can travel around safely and what you can experience there. / Jarenlang was El Salvador veel te gevaarlijk voor toeristen en ook voor Reizen Waes. Tom trekt naar El Salvador om te ontdekken of je er veilig kan rondreizen en wat je er allemaal kan beleven.

programme.title: Nothing to see / Niks te zien
programme.desc: With singer Nathalie Meskens to Cape Town in South Africa, not with singer Nathalie Meskens, not with their eyes but with their ears. They immerse themselves in the sound of the War Cries of RugbyPorters, defy the waves of Muizenberg Beach without their sight, and look for the king of the jungle, who carries a silent secret next to his loud roar. Nathalie closes the journey with a new song as a reminder. / Slechtziende Karl Meesters trekt met zangeres Nathalie Meskens naar Kaapstad in Zuid-Afrika, niet met hun ogen maar met hun oren op scherp. programme.title: A nation witness / Narod priča
programme.desc: The new format, the author's travel-recorted journalist Biljana Stokic, discovery what the heart of the people tells about the Serbian, the tradition and history of our cities and villages, their everyday life and the struggle for preserving true values, diligent work, faith, and love for theirs and ours, Otamb. U spletu iskrenih priča onih koji žive od svog rada, kroz otkrivanje znamenitosti i prirodnih ljepota naše zemlje i njihovih domova, uz riječi nade i inspiracije, te uz slike od kojih se rastopi srce, sa vedrinom koja porazi sve prepreke i probleme, Biljana Stokić će, dugogodišnjim novinarskim iskustvom, zaviriti u njihovu svakodnevicu. Kako živi običan čovjek? Koji su njegovi problemi i izazovi? U čemu nalazi snagu za radom i njegovanje tradicije i dobrih međuljudskih odnosa? Kako diše naša rodna gruda i ima li joj u ljepoti ravne? programme.title: The fountain of life / Fontana života
programme.desc: Born from the human sacrifice, the legendary tree of life promises immortality to anyone who drinks her juices. The search for a magical tree or more importantly, for his gift, obsessing with Tom for a thousand years. Told without the Chronological Order, the film of the fountain of life follows Tom's soul through three different incarnations, and during each of them, he desperately seeks to save the life of his soulmate, Iszi. First we get acquainted with Thomas, a conquistador in the 16th century serving Queen Isabel. In order to save Spain from the Inquisition, he was tasked with finding a tree, and referring to fearless soldiers in the enigmatic Mayan Jungle. In modern times, Dr. Tom Creo participates in a revolutionary research of brain tumors. He becomes obsessed with when his wife also disappears from the tumor, and she has only a few days of life. He is especially interesting to him, which gives incredible results in the treatment of that disease. As there is a little valuable time, Tom must hurry up with his research. Light years further, Tommy transferred the tree to the mystical part of the galaxy. As he remembers the Izzia and his past lives, he travels to a fog, which, once he arrives, promises both of both re -birth and going to the world. Roles: Hugh Jackman, Rachel Weisz, Ellen Burstyn, Mark Margolis, Stephen Mchattie Directed: Darren Aronofsky / Rođeno iz ljudske žrtve, legendarno drvo života obećava besmrtnost svakomu ko popije njene sokove. Potraga za čarobnim stablom ili još važnije, za njegovim darom, opsjeda Toma tokom hiljadu godina. Ispričana bez hronološkoga reda, film Fontana života slijedi Tomovu dušu kroz tri različite inkarnacije, i tokom svake od njih on očajnički nastoji spasiti život svojoj srodnoj duši, Izzi. Prvo se upoznajemo s Tomasom, konkvistadorom u 16. stoljeću koji služi kraljici Isabel. Kako bi spasio Španjolsku od Inkvizicije, dobio je zadatak da nađe drvo, i upućuje se s neustrašivim vojnicima u zagonetnu majansku džunglu. U moderno doba dr. Tom Creo sudjeluje u revolucionarnom istraživanju tumora mozga. Postane opsjednut time kada se i njegova žena Izzie razboli od tumora, i ostane joj svega nekoliko dana života. Naročito mu je zanimljivo drvo koje daje nevjerojatne rezultate u liječenju te bolesti. Kako ima malo dragocjenog vremena, Tom mora požuriti sa svojim istraživanjem. Svjetlosnim godinama dalje, Tommy prenese drvo u mističan dio galaksije. Dok se sjeća Izzie i svojih prošlih života, putuje u maglicu koja, kada jednom stigne, obećava oboma ponovno rođenje i odlazak u svijet. Uloge: Hugh Jackman, Rachel Weisz, Ellen Burstyn, Mark Margolis, Stephen McHattie Režija: Darren Aronofsky

programme.title: Fabric stories / Priče iz fabrike
programme.desc: In the textile factory "Star", in a small Bosnian place, 800 women employed. Young, ambitious Ivan Đaković, the son of one of the workers. Ivan wants to modernize the work of the factory and amend some established rules. He encounters the resistance of the former management of the factory and political circles. Workers are distrustful of the young director who completed the faculty in Belgrade and has no experience. They gossip him in front of his mother, who also works in the factory. In the house of Ivan's mother, as a tenant, he lives clear. The factory warns Ivan to have a criminal file for robbery and should be fired. Ivan doesn't want that because Jasna has been aging her sentence. The workers reveal that clear came out of prison and raises a chase against her. Jasna alone goes from the apartment and from the factory. Ivanu is because of that sorry. Roles: Branislav Lečić, Mira Stupica, Zoran Radmilović, Minca Muftić, Miralem Zubčević, Nada Đurevska, Svetlana Bojković, Vladica Milosavljević ... Director: Vojislav Milašević / U fabrici tekstila "Zvijezda", u malom bosanskom mjestu, zaposleno je 800 žena. Na mjesto direktora dolazi mladi, ambiciozni Ivan Đaković, sin jedne od radnica. Ivan želi modernizovati rad fabrike i izmijeniti neka ustaljena pravila. Nailazi na otpor dotadašnjeg rukovodstva fabrike i političkih krugova. Radnice su nepovjerljive prema mladom direktoru koji je završio fakultet u Beogradu i nema iskustva. Ogovaraju ga pred njegovom majkom, koja također radi u fabrici. U kući Ivanove majke, kao podstanarka, živi Jasna. U fabrici upozoravaju Ivana da ona ima kriminalni dosije zbog pljačke i da je treba otpustiti. Ivan to ne želi jer je Jasna odležala svoju kaznu. Radnice otkrivaju da je Jasna izašla iz zatvora i diže se hajka protiv nje. Jasna sama odlazi iz stana i iz fabrike. Ivanu je zbog toga žao. Uloge: Branislav Lečić, Mira Stupica, Zoran Radmilović, Minka Muftić, Miralem Zubčević, Nada Đurevska, Svetlana Bojković, Vladica Milosavljević... Režija: Vojislav Milašević

programme.title: Victims of love / Žrtve ljubavi
programme.desc: In the background of social rebellions and class struggles in Italy just before World War I, two passionate love stories and one great story of the victim are intertwined. Carrara, 1913, the young Brando works in the marble mine in Colonnati, owned by engineer Corradi. Brando is an idealist who struggles to improve the dug working conditions. A serious accident that happens to a miner takes him to the Holy Crown Hospital led by the honorable mother Agnese. At that point, the suffering meets Silvia, who volunteers as a nurse. The brand immediately touches the deep humanity of a young woman, and later returned to the hospital to meet her again. Among the attraction, they feel they share the same ideals. Leopoldo Corradi, the most influential person in the city, suggested to his son Corrad to run for MP Carrara, making her first son Albert. Young housekeeper Maddalena, a sister's brand, is under sharp and constant criticism of Mrs. Maffei, who rejects her permit for Maddalena's free evening so that she can celebrate her birthday with the family. The brand overwhelms the anger for this new act of abuse, goes to the Corradi villa, and reveals that Silvia is, in fact, the wife of his boss Corrad Corradi. Roots: Francesca Valtort, Giorgio Lupano, Rocco Giusti, Desiree NoFereini, Federica de Benedittis / U pozadini društvenih pobuna i klasnih borbi u Italiji malo prije Prvog svjetskog rata prepleću se dvije strastvene ljubavne priče i jedna velika priča o žrtvi.Carrara, 1913., mladi Brando radi u rudniku mramora u Colonnati, čiji je vlasnik inženjer Corradi. Brando je idealista koji se bori da poboljša uvjete rada kopača. Teška nesreća koja se dogodi jednom rudaru odvede ga u bolnicu Sveta Kruna koju vodi časna majka Agnese. Na tom mjestu patnji upoznaje Silviju, koja volontira kao medicinska sestra. Branda smjesta dirne duboka ljudskost mlade žene, te se on naknadno vrati u bolnicu kako bi je ponovno susreo. Među, pored privlačnosti, oni osjete da dijele iste ideale. Leopoldo Corradi, najutjecajnija osoba u gradu, predloži svom sinu Corradu da se kandidira za zastupnika okruga Carrara, čime naljuti svog prvog sina Alberta. Mlada kućna pomoćnica Maddalena, Brandova sestra,pod oštrim je i stalnim kritikama gđice Maffei, koja joj odbije dozvolu za Maddalenino slobodno veče, kako bi mogla proslaviti svoj rođendan sa porodicom. Branda obuzima gnjev zbog tog novog čina zlostavljanja, odlazi u vilu Corradijevih, a tamo otkrije da je Silvia, zapravo, žena njegovog gazde Corrada Corradija. Uloge: Francesca Valtorta, Giorgio Lupano, Rocco Giusti, Desiree Nofereini, Federica De Benedittis

Collections and collections do not even lag behind the settings in reputable European and world museums. This form of BHRT wants to present them to the general public and remind them of their value. The stories are processed only by basic and most interesting details, with the aim of encouraging viewers to visit museums and institutions in which exhibits are found. In the fundus you will see the interesting facts you haven't known so far, the items you haven't seen before, and it will also present part of the tradition on which there is no information recorded. / "Fundus" je format TV priča čije su teme bh. kulturno-historijsko naslijeđe, nepoznate priče i detalji iz naše baštine, ali i podsjećanje na vrijedno kulturno blago koje čuvaju muzeji širom zemlje. Najbolja promocija države je preko njene bogate i raznovrsne kulture. Muzejski depoi čuvaju hiljade vrijednih predmeta i eksponata, među kojima su brojni svjetski rariteti. Kolekcije i zbirke ni po čemu ne zaostaju za postavkama u uglednim evropskim i svjetskim muzejima. Ovom formom BHRT želi da ih predstavi široj javnosti i podsjeti na njihovu vrijednost. Priče obrađuju samo osnovne i najzanimljivije detalje, s ciljem da potaknu gledatelje da za više informacija posjete muzeje i ustanove u kojima se nalaze eksponati. U Fundusu ćete vidjeti zanimljivosti koje do sada niste znali, predmete koje niste prije vidjeli, a predstaviće i dio tradicije o kojoj nema zabilježenih informacija.

programme.title: Sports focus / Sport Fokus
programme.desc: New Season Magazine Sport Focus is ahead with us with novelties in the content, but in the same term and the same format! In the first show, they will receive a football WWIN LIGA BiH with the professional analysis of our consultant of Kemal Alispahić. We will look back at the performance of our Davis Cup national team against Ecuador. We will also present two new columns, the "Alphabet of Sports" in which the actors will talk about the basics of its sports, rules and competitions, ie "inosport weeks", as a reminder of the most deserted sports events on the international scene. / Nova sezona magazina Sport fokus je pred nama sa novitetima u sadržaju, ali u istom terminu i istom formatu! U prvoj emisiji primat će imati nogometna Wwin liga BiH uz stručnu analizu našeg konsultanta Kemala Alispahića. Osvrnut ćemo se na nastup naše Davis cup reprezentaciju protiv Ekvadora. Predstavit ćemo i dvije nove rubrike, "Abeceda sporta" u kojoj će akteri pričati o osnovama svojih sportova, pravilima i takmičenjima, odnosno "Inosport sedmica", kao podsjetnik na najzačajnije sportske događaje na međunarodnoj sceni.

programme.title: Lincoln: In the shadow of division / Lincoln: U sjeni podjela
programme.desc: Just before the assassination, Lincoln is transformed from the controversial figure on the rudder the largest crisis in America, to the hero of martyrs. After his brutal murder, in this episode of hunting on his killer, his knowledge of his wife and the state he left behind. America is full of racial conflicts, and its murder launches a hundred-year struggle for civil rights, from Jim Crow to the Movement "Black Lives Matter". Lincoln is marked as a lifeguard and hero, he was turned into a myth, but reality is much more complex. If he must be believed that he represents what is the state, people then have to see his evolution that will inspire everything to learn, develop and change, as he did. / Neposredno prije atentata, Lincoln se preobražava iz kontroverzne figure na kormilu najveće krize u Americi, do heroja mučenika. Nakon njegovog brutalnog ubistva, u ovoj epizodi o lovu na njegovog ubicu, saznanjima o njegovoj supruzi i državi koju je ostavio iza sebe. Amerika je prepuna rasnih sukoba, a njegovo ubistvo pokreće stogodišnju borbu za građanska prava, od Jima Crowa do pokreta "Black Lives Matter". Lincoln je označen kao spasilac i heroj, pretvoren je u mit, ali stvarnost je mnogo kompleksnija. Ako se mora vjerovati da on predstavlja ono što je država, ljudi onda moraju sagledati njegovu evoluciju koja će inspirisati sve da uče, razvijaju i mijenjaju se, kao što je on to radio.

programme.desc: The mysteries of Dr. Blake (The Doctor: The Doctor Blake Mysteries) is an Australian television series first aired on ABC on February 1, 2013 at 8:30 pm [1]. Creg Dugal McLlan is in the role of Dr. Lucien Blake, who returned to Balarat, northwest of Melbourne, in the late 1950s, to take over the general medical practice of his late father and the role of a police surgeon after 30 years. Five seasons have been broadcast until 2017, after which the program is closed at the end of the fifth season. The first two seasons have 10 episodes while the next ones have 8 each. Each episode is about an hour - between 56 and 59 minutes. / Мистериите на доктор Блейк (на английски: The Doctor Blake Mysteries) е австралийски телевизионен сериал, излъчен за първи път по ABC на 1 февруари 2013 г. в 20:30 часа[1]. Крег Дугъл Маклалън е в ролята на доктор Лусиен Блейк, който се завръща в Баларат, северозападно от Мелбърн, в края на 1950-те години, за да поеме общата медицинска практика на покойния си баща и ролята на полицейски хирург след отсъствие от 30 години. Пет сезона се излъчват до 2017 г., след което програмата е закрита в края на петия сезон. Първите два сезона имат 10 епизода докато следващите имат по 8. programme.title: Tennis: Davis Cup: Match 3: Croatia - France / Тенис: Купа Дейвис: Мач 3: Хърватия - Франция
programme.desc: The tournament was established in 1900 at the initiative of American tennis player Dwight Davis, with the first edition being a meeting between the US and the UK. Gradually, the race is growing and today is among the largest sporting events with the participation of many countries around the world. Each clash is held in format up to three wins from five matches - on the first day two singles are played, and in the second one follows a match in pairs and two reverse singles. Since 2019, the structure of the tournament has been upgraded and already includes qualification stages, group phase and final eight, in which the top eight teams argue for the award. / Турнирът е създаден през 1900 г. по инициатива на американския тенисист Дуайт Дейвис, като първото издание е било среща между САЩ и Великобритания. Постепенно надпреварата се разраства и днес е сред най-мащабните спортни събития с участие на множество държави от целия свят. Всеки сблъсък се провежда във формат до три победи от пет срещи – в първия ден се изиграват два сингъла, а във втория следват мач по двойки и два обратни сингъла. От 2019 г. структурата на турнира е модернизирана, като вече включва квалификационни етапи, групова фаза и финална осмица, в която най-добрите осем отбора спорят за отличието.

programme.title: Football: League 1 in France: 4 round: lil - Toulouse / Футбол: Лига 1 на Франция: 4 кръг: Лил - Тулуза
programme.desc: League 1 consists of 20 teams that compete against each other in 38 rounds, changed. The French Championship dates from 1892, the so -called Amateur League until 1929. In 1932, the foundations of professionally organized football in France were laid. The French Division 1 includes in its first season 1932-33 the following teams, divided into two groups: Club France, Excelsior, Ier, Lille, Marseille, Muluz, Nice, Nim, Racing Paris, Ale, Antib, Khan, are Paris, Fiv, Montz, Red Star, Ren and Sosho. In recent years, much later, the formed club Paris Saint-Germain has been an absolute dominant on the home stage, but before that, Lyon, Marseille, Bordeaux, Monaco, Nan, Saint Etienne, Reim, Nice, Lance and more have also had many successes. / Лига 1 се състои от 20 отбора, които се състезават един срещу друг в 38 кръга, на разменено гостуване. Френският шампионат датира от 1892, така нареченета Аматьорска лига до 1929. През 1932 се полагат основите на професионално организраният футбол във Франция. Френската Дивизия 1 включва в своя първи сезон 1932-33 следните отбори, разделени в две групи: Клуб Франсе, Екселсиор, Иер, Лил, Марсилия, Мюлуз, Ница, Ним, Расинг Париж, Сет, Але, Антиб, Кан, СА Париж, Фив, Метц, Монпелие, Ред Стар, Рен и Сошо. През последните години доста по-късно сформирания клуб Пари Сен Жермен е абсолютен доминатор на домашната сцена, но преди това много успехи са имали също Лион, Марсилия, Бордо, Монако, Нан, Сен Етиен, Рейм, Ница, Ланс и др.

Na pravni i etički pristup raznim problemima i rješenjima u društvu najviše utječe država sa svojim političarima, ali provjerili smo ulogu Crkve i kršćanstva, na sjeveru su u većini protestanti luterani, u Italiji katolici, u Grčkoj pravoslavni. U Grčkoj i Italiji samo da se očuva milenijska baština ne bilo dovoljno pola državnog proračuna, a svaki je kamen, svaki stup, svaki kip, svaka palača neprocjenjive vrijednosti. programme.title: The most beautiful gardens of Dubrovnik / Najljepši vrtovi Dubrovnika
programme.desc: The most beautiful gardens of Dubrovnik - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2024) recognizable for its unique architecture and history, Dubrovnik, the city of stone hides rare but very interesting green oases. Although the notion of the Renaissance Garden of Dubrovnik is significant in the development of Croatian landscape art, contemporary gardens today tell a new story, closely related to its owners. Despite the fact that these gardens are closed to the public, the author and manager of Kornelija Benyovsky Šoštarić will open their door and take a peek at the unusual green oasis of the old town of Dubrovnik, as well as its immediate surroundings like the island of Lopud. The show is dedicated to people whose greenery is an important part of the culture of life and who are willing to enhance their living space to plants despite all the challenges and the cramped space of the city. In a fun, educational and inspirational way, we learn anecdotes about the emergence of these gardens and get to know people who love and maintain them. R.: Nino Šoštarić ... / Najljepši vrtovi Dubrovnika - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2024) Prepoznatljiv po svojoj jedinstvenoj arhitekturi i povijesti, Dubrovnik, grad od kamena skriva i rijetke, ali vrlo zanimljive zelene oaze. Iako je pojam dubrovačkog renesansnog vrta značajan u razvoju hrvatske pejzažne umjetnosti, suvremeni vrtovi danas pričaju neku novu priču, usko povezanu uz svoje vlasnike. Unatoč tome što su ti vrtovi zatvoreni za javnost, autorica i voditeljica Kornelija Benyovsky Šoštarić otvoriti će njihova vrata i zaviriti u neobične zelene oaze starog grada Dubrovnika, ali i njegove neposredne okolice poput otoka Lopuda. Emisija je posvećena ljudima kojima je zelenilo važan dio kulture življenja i koji su spremni oplemeniti svoj životni prostor biljkama unatoč svim izazovima i skučenom prostoru grada. Na zabavan, edukativan i inspirativan način, doznajemo anegdote o nastanku tih vrtova i upoznajemo ljude koji ih vole i održavaju. R.: Nino Šoštarić...

programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E24, feature series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Promess owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E24, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.desc: Veljko from the sea - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2023) Veljko Rogosic ... The one swimming around the world, with sharks and dolphins, rebuilding records and advertising juices and wine, star in an unattractive sport such as a remote swim, 203 times the Yugoslav national team, winner of the medal at many championships, a man who knocked down the national records 147 times. And the one who cares that somewhere in the open sea, competes with himself. He won the world championship four times, seven times he was named the best marathon of the world, is a multiple world record holder in a remote swim. In his sports treasury at the house in Kastel Luksic, there are more than 1450 cups, medals, plaques, diplomas and recognitions. This is a portrait of a swimmer who swam the world 8 times, Dalmatian, a good father and grandfather. Sam calculated that he spent almost a third of his life in the seas, lakes and rivers. He made so much solem that, if everyone was added up, he could sail the world eight times. And therefore, it is no wonder that he was called by a man of fish, a sea man, a sea wolf, a dolphin, a catamaran ... As many as 142 times he was a national champion in various disciplines, and the national records had been over 51 times! He is probably a world record holder by the number of advertisements recorded. He is the holder of the headline "King of Cold Water" (1976), "a resident" is a swimming house of the famous Florida (1992), entered the Guinness Book of Records, swirling 225 kilometers without getting out of the water on the route of Gradacine (2006). He won in the Italian Riccione, where he won the first world champion title. He was the best at the marathons in Saguenay, Alexandria, Sydney, Cook's passage, Mar del Plate and on Lake Ontario, where he also set a world record. The news of his sub -tests stood in two sentences of the sports section of the diary, after which positive energy, the breath of victory, the thought of which these unknown toponyms would be breaths, which brings Veljko to the miraculous way. World Marathon Plivari Federation (WPMSF) ... / Veljko od mora - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2023) Veljko Rogošić... Onaj što pliva oko svijeta, s morskim psima i dupinima, što obara rekorde i reklamira sokove i vino, zvijezda u neatraktivnom sportu kakav je daljinsko plivanje, 203 puta reprezentativac Jugoslavije, osvajač medalja na mnogim prvenstvima, čovjek koji je 147 puta rušio državne rekorde i snimio 127 reklama. I onaj kome je stalo da se, negdje na pučini, natječe sam sa sobom. Četiri puta okitio se naslovom svjetskog prvaka, sedam puta proglašen je najboljim maratoncem svijeta, višestruki je svjetski rekorder u daljinskom plivanju. U njegovoj sportskoj riznici u kući u Kaštel Lukšiću više je od 1450 pehara, medalja, plaketa, diploma i priznanja. Ovo je portret plivača koji je 8 puta preplivao svijet, Dalmatinca, dobrog oca i djeda. Sam je izračunao da je u morima, jezerima i rijekama proveo gotovo trećinu života. Napravio je toliko zaveslaja da bi, kada bi se svi zbrojili, mogao osam puta oploviti svijet. I stoga nije čudno što su ga zvali čovjek riba, morski čovik, morski vuk, dupin, katamaran... Čak 142 puta je bio državni prvak u raznim disciplinama, a državne je rekorde obarao čak 51 put! Vjerojatno je i svjetski rekorder po broju snimljenih reklama. Nositelj je naslova "Kralj hladnih voda" (1976.), "stanovnik" je plivačke Kuće slavnih na Floridi (1992.), ušao je u Guinnessovu knjigu rekorda, preplivavši 225 kilometara ne izlazeći iz vode na relaciji Grado - Riccione (2006.). Pobjeđivao je u talijanskom Riccioneu, gde je osvojio prvu titulu svjetskog prvaka. Bio je najbolji na maratonima u Saguenayu, Aleksandriji, Sydneyju, Cookovom prolazu, Mar del Plati i na jezeru Ontario, gde je postavio i svjetski rekord. Vijesti o njegovim podvizima stale su u dvije rečenice sportske rubrike Dnevnika, poslije kojih bi prostrujali pozitivna energija, dah pobjede, misao o tome gde su ti nepoznati toponimi koje svojim zaveslajima Veljko spaja na čudesan način. Svjetski savez profesionalnih plivača maratonaca (WPMSF)...

programme.title: Great American journey SUE PERKINS / Veliko američko putovanje Sue Perkins
programme.desc: Sue Perkins Big American Road Trip - (E01, Tourism Program, England, 2022) This is a good view of the modern American phenomenon of life in the caravan. Sue was never one of those who often camped, but she always dreamed of a life spent outdoors and on the move, about sitting at the steering wheel, squeezing gas and looking at where the way would take her. She will not be enough for the experience of traveling by the road. He has to expand the horizons and go on a trip through the two most beautiful US states, Colorado and California, in his own camper, to discover all the benefits and flaws of life on the road. In America, more than a million people have moved on to this completely new way of life and replaced their homes for homes on wheels, so they wander to cult landscapes and use social media, motivating other passengers. Sue wants to try out that lifestyle first -hand and get to know the people whose life in the caravan has become the only thing they need, some who have been forced to do so and some who wanted it - from those who did not realize the American dream after all their life of painstaking work, to those who seek adventures, freedom and exit from the gungle ... and all between all this. ------ join Sue Perkins at the first section of her Odysseus in Camper as she travels to the golden state of California, attractive to every adventure of the road trip, with vineyards, legendary routes, high forests and a magnificent coast. At the steering wheel of their new home, the legendary Pacific coast highway and meets Blix and Bess, a couple who left their established life less than a year ago - a new generation of caravan residents, with a new attitude towards life on a movement, remaining networked and employed while enjoying freedom of wandering. Sue goes on to interior to one of the most famous national parks in the US, Yosemitea, and meets Alexandri - one of the first young solitary lonely who joined the movement of life in Karavan. R .: Erin Heidenreich Ul.: Sue Perkins (Self - Present) ... / Sue Perkins Big American Road Trip - (E01, turistički program, Engleska, 2022) Ovo je dobronamjeran pogled na moderni američki fenomen života u karavanu. Sue nikad nije bila od onih što često kampiraju, ali je uvijek maštala o životu provedenom na otvorenom i u pokretu, o tome da sjedne za upravljač, stisne gas i gleda kamo će je put odvesti. Za doživljaj putovanja cestom vožnja po A1 neće joj biti dovoljna. Mora proširiti horizonte i poći na put kroz dvije najljepše američke države, Colorado i Kaliforniju, u vlastitom kamperu, da otkrije sve prednosti i mane života na cesti. U Americi je više od milijun ljudi prešlo na taj posve novi način života i zamijenilo svoje kuće za domove na kotačima pa lutaju kultnim krajolicima i služe se društvenim medijima motivirajući i druge putnike. Sue želi iz prve ruke iskušati taj životni stil i upoznati ljude kojima je život u karavanu postao jedino što im treba, neke koji su na to bili prisiljeni i neke koji su to htjeli - od onih kojima se američki san nije ostvario nakon cijelog života mukotrpnog rada, do onih koji traže pustolovine, slobodu i izlaz iz gungule... i sve između svega toga. ----- Pridružite se Sue Perkins na prvome odsječku njezine odiseje u kamperu dok putuje zlatnom državom Kalifornijom, privlačnom svakom pustolovu cestovnog putovanja, s vinogradima, legendarnim rutama, visokim šumama i veličanstvenom obalom. Za upravljačem svojega novog doma Sue vozi legendarnom autocestom Pacifičke obale te upozna Blix i Bess, par koji je napustio svoj ustaljeni život prije manje od godinu dana - novu generaciju stanovnika karavana, s novim stavom prema životu u pokretu, pri čemu ostaju umrežene i zaposlene, dok uživaju u slobodi lutanja. Sue dalje nastavlja prema unutrašnjosti do jednog od najpoznatijih nacionalnih parkova u SAD-u, Yosemitea, i upoznaje Alexandriju - jednu od prvih mladih samotnjakinja koje su se pridružile pokretu života u karavanu. programme.title: It's time for jazz / Vrijeme je za jazz
programme.desc: Time for jazz - (e01, music. Emissions, Croatia, in 1961. in Kobe in Japan, Makoto Ozone nurtures the intensive career Jazz and the classical musician, merging in their performances a lot of influences. When he held a solo recital in Carnegie Hall, after which he became the first Japanese artist who signed an exclusive contract with CBS and published his first album - Makoto Ozone. Numerous recognitions, including the highest Award of the Japanese government for the contribution to national cultural life, and the nomination for Grammy, follow his career during which he collaborated with the largest names of the international jazz scene. As part of the many guest appearances, in 1988, in Zagreb Jazz Fair, and on Jam Session in B. P. Club where he was musicians with Bosko Petrović. This is his first visit to Zagreb after that. Some of the concerts of performed compositions were created for that orchestra, while some ozone was performed by solo and in smaller compositions. Р.: СтрокT Гргиц ... / Vrijeme je za jazz - (E01, glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2012) Rođen 1961. u Kobeu u Japanu, Makoto Ozone njeguje intenzivnu karijeru jazz i klasičnog glazbenika, spajajući u svojim izvedbama mnoštvo utjecaja. Oscar Peterson, Gary Burton i Duke Ellington samo su neki od njegovih uzora i mentora. Jazzom se zarazio već u ranom djetinjstvu zahvaljujući ocu, jazz orguljašu, a školovao se na Berklee College of Music. Pažnju javnosti privukao je 1983. kada je održao solistički recital u Carnegie Hallu, nakon čega je postao prvi japanski umjetnik koji je potpisao ekskluzivni ugovor sa CBS-om te objavio svoj prvi album - Makoto Ozone. Brojna priznanja, među kojima su najviša nagrada japanske Vlade za doprinos nacionalnom kulturnom životu te nominacija za Grammy, prate njegovu karijeru tijekom koje je surađivao s najvećim imenima međunarodne jazz scene. U sklopu brojnih gostovanja nastupio je i u Zagrebu 1988. godine, na zagrebačkom Jazz Fairu, te na jam sessionu u B. P. Clubu gdje je muzicirao s Boškom Petrovićem. Ovo je njegovo prvo gostovanje u Zagrebu nakon toga. Održao je dva koncerta - sa Simfonijskim orkestrom HRT-a i Jazz orkestrom HRT-a. programme.title: Ernest Weissmann / Ernest Weissmann
programme.desc: Ernest Weissmann - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2023) Ernest Weissmann, Croatian Architect of International Career, six turbulent decades of the 20th century, persisted in the construction of its vision of a better world - design of public buildings, building and urban planning in the service of ordinary people, sustainable and humane world. After graduating from the Faculty of Technical at the University of Zagreb in 1926, he trained with the leading world architects of Adolf Loos and Le Corbusier in Paris. Weissmann was a Croatian architect in continuity present on the European and later world architectural scene, not in the function of a passive observer but a co -creator. He was a socially responsible and engaged architect for which architecture was a tool for solving social problems. His interest in the new world also included new media, photography and film, and regularly recorded the processes of new buildings as well as daily moments of working in the studio or socializing with colleagues. The rich archival material that has left, with statements of world experts, theorists and historians of architecture, they paint the time in which Weissmann acted and its influences on the domestic and international architectural scene. R.: Ana Marija Habjan ... / Ernest Weissmann - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2023) Ernest Weissmann, hrvatski arhitekt međunarodne karijere, šest turbulentih desetljeća 20. stoljeća ustrajao je u izgradnji svoje vizije boljega svijeta - projektiranju javnih zgrada, građenju i urbanističkom planiranju u službi običnih ljudi, održivog i humanog svijeta. Nakon diplome na Tehničkom fakultetu Sveučilišta u Zagrebu 1926., usavršavao se kod vodećih svjetskih arhitekata Adolfa Loosa i Le Corbusiera u Parizu. Weissmann je bio jedni hrvatski arhitekt u kontinuitetu prisutan na europskoj, a kasnije i svjetskoj arhitektonskoj sceni, ne u funkciji pasivnog promatrača nego sukreatora. Bio je društveno odgovoran i angažiran arhitekt za kojeg je arhitektura bila alat za rješavanje društvenih problema. Njegovo zanimanje za novi svijet uključivalo je i nove medije, fotografiju i film, te je redovito snimao procese nastanka novih građevina ali i svakodnevne trenutke rada u atelijeru ili druženja s kolegama. Bogat arhivski materijal koji je ostavio, uz izjave svjetskih stručnjaka, teoretičara i povjesničara arhitekture, oslikavaju vrijeme u kojem je Weissmann djelovao te njegove utjecaje na domaću i međunarodnu arhitektonsku scenu. R.: Ana Marija Habjan...

programme.title: Blagoje Bersa: Flower, Concert performance of Opera - KD V. Lisinski / Blagoje Bersa: Oganj, koncertna izvedba opere - KD V. Lisinski
programme.desc: Blagoje Bersa: Oganj, Concert performance of Opera - KD V. Lisinski - (Show Magazine, Croatia, 2024) The cooperation of the Croatian Radio and Television, the Croatian National Theater in Zagreb and the Vatroslav Lisinski Concert Hall in the Canconyer cycle, on January 18, 2024. Berse. The concert performance on the occasion of the 150th anniversary of the birth and 90th anniversary of the death of the composer was attended by soloists, champions of Zagreb opera-Valentina Fijacko Kobić, Stjepan Franevović, Ljubomir Puškarić, Luciano Batinić, Siniša Stork and Siniša Hapač, and the Choir and Symphony Orchestra of HRT, HRT. The performance was led by Maestro Aleksandar Markovic. Blagoje Bersa is one of the most influential Croatian composers and musical educators whose musical oeuvre and action have significantly characterized the Croatian music of the period of modern and the first half of the 20th century. Born in Dubrovnik, educated in Vienna, Zagreb, Trieste and Zadar, Opera Oganj began to compose in 1905 in Zadar and completed it in 1906 in Vienna. Although Bersa sought to be premiered in Vienna, this did not happen, so the original German libretto of Alfred Marie Willner, with the title Der Eisenhammer, translated Ferdo Zivko Miller into Croatian by leaning. It was first staged on January 12, 1911 at the Croatian National Theater in Zagreb, and the Zagreb audience, as well as criticism, welcomed the performance with enthusiasm. Antun Gustav Matos called the fire "The first artistic opera of the high and modern style created by a Croat," especially praising "the brilliant orchestral part", Josip Andric said "standing worthy among the works that European music received them in the time of a quarter of a century ago", and Lujo Saffranek-Kavic called Bersa "inspired by Bersa who is a perfect manner who the apparatus. " The opera was performed only in 2003 at the Croatian National Theater in Zagreb. This concert performance on the occasion of the 150th anniversary of his ... / Blagoje Bersa: Oganj, koncertna izvedba opere - KD V. Lisinski - (show magazin, Hrvatska, 2024) Suradnja Hrvatske radiotelevizije, Hrvatskog narodnog kazališta u Zagrebu i Koncertne dvorane Vatroslava Lisinskog u ciklusu Kanconijer, 18. siječnja 2024. iznjedrila je prvu integralnu izvedbu jednog od kapitalnih djela hrvatske glazbe 20. stoljeća - operu Oganj Blagoja Berse. U koncertnoj izvedbi u povodu 150. godišnjice rođenja i 90. godišnjice smrti skladatelja sudjelovali su solisti, prvaci zagrebačke Opere - Valentina Fijačko Kobić, Stjepan Franetović, Ljubomir Puškarić, Luciano Batinić, Siniša Štork i Siniša Hapač, te Zbor i Simfonijski orkestar HRT-a, Zbor HNK-a Zagreb i Dječji zbor HRT-a. Izvedbu je predvodio maestro Aleksandar Marković. Blagoje Bersa jedan je od najutjecajnijih hrvatskih skladatelja i glazbenih pedagoga čiji su glazbeni opus i djelovanje bitno obilježili hrvatsku glazbu razdoblja moderne i prve polovice 20. stoljeća. Rođen u Dubrovniku, školovan u Beču, Zagrebu, Trstu i Zadru, operu Oganj počeo je skladati 1905. u Zadru i dovršio je 1906. u Beču. Iako je Bersa nastojao da se djelo praizvede u Beču, to se nije dogodilo, stoga je i izvorni njemački libreto Alfreda Marie Willnera, s naslovom Der Eisenhammer, na hrvatski preveo Ferdo Živko Miler naslovivši djelo Oganj. Prvi je put uprizorena 12. siječnja 1911. godine u Hrvatskome narodnom kazalištu u Zagrebu, a zagrebačka publika, kao i kritika, izvedbu je dočekala s oduševljenjem. Antun Gustav Matoš nazvao je Oganj "prvom umjetničkom operom visokog i modernog stila koju stvori Hrvat", osobito hvaleći "briljantni orkestralni dio", Josip Andrić ocijenio je da "stoji dostojno među djelima što ih je europska glazba dobila u doba prije četvrt stoljeća", a Lujo Šafranek-Kavić nazvao je Bersu "inspiriranim majstorom koji savršeno vlada čitavim aparatom". Opera je na izvorniku (pra)izvedena tek 2003. godine u Hrvatskom narodnom kazalištu u Zagrebu. Ova koncertna izvedba u povodu 150. obljetnice njegova ...

programme.title: Rudolf Steiner - Modus vivendi / Rudolf Steiner - Modus vivendi
programme.desc: Rudolf Steiner - Modus Vivendi - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2007) This intriguing biography and spiritual travelogue represents the work of Rudolf Steiner, founder of anthroposophy, Austrian philosopher, scientist and visionary born in Croatia. Steiner accurately described the appearance of the moon stones, anticipated the fall of the Bolshevik system, the appearance of internet culture and cow's madness, but also gave instructions for the treatment of tumor diseases with mistletoe, as well as many other truths that are applied today in pedagogy, agriculture, medicine ... The film takes us through Steiner's legacy revealing unknown details about his life. The place of birth of Donji Kraljevec and the place of the death of Dornach in Switzerland visits every year an increasing number of visitors to the eager answers to eternal questions: Who are we, what are we and where are we going? He gave many answers to Steiner, predicted many. In the second part of the film, we get to know the importance of the art of eurithmia, Waldorf pedagogy, the work of the Handicapped Community as well as biodynamic agriculture. The film was shown in the Anthropological category in 2008 at the Chinese Golden Panda Festival in Sechuan. R.: Mladen Santric ... / Rudolf Steiner - Modus vivendi - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2007) Ova intrigantna biografija i duhovni putopis predstavlja djelo Rudolfa Steinera, utemeljitelja antropozofije, austrijskog filozofa, znanstvenika i vizionara rođenog u Hrvatskoj. Steiner je točno opisao izgled Mjesečevog kamenja, predvidio pad boljševičkog sistema, pojavu internet kulture i kravljeg ludila, ali i dao upute za liječenje tumorskih bolesti imelom, kao i mnogo drugih istina koje se danas primjenjuju u pedagogiji, poljoprivredi, medicini... Film nas vodi kroz Steinerovu ostavštinu otkrivajući nepoznate detalje o njegovom životu i djelu, o "duhovnoj znanosti" koju je utemeljio. Mjesto rođenja Donji Kraljevec i mjesto smrti Dornach u Švicarskoj svake godine posjećuje sve veći broj posjetitelja željnih odgovora na vječna pitanja: tko smo, što smo i kamo idemo? Mnoge je odgovore Steiner dao, mnoge predvidio. U drugom dijelu filma upoznajemo značaj umijeća euritmije, waldorfske pedagogije, rad zajednica za hendikepirane kao i biodinamičku poljoprivredu. Film je 2008. prikazan u antropološkoj kategoriji na kineskom festivalu "Zlatna panda" u Sechuanu. R.: Mladen Santrić...

programme.title: Sola of life / Sol života
programme.desc: Salt of Life - (E01, Doc. Series, Croatia, 2005) Salt is a natural mineral and a product needed for a life of man and livestock. The use of salt in modern life has spread to various areas in the craft and industry. Today, it's hard to imagine what Salt has meant in the past. It was a valuable product that determined the market as it is determined today by oil consumption. Her production was limited and supervised, because it was almost everywhere a state monopoly. This monopoly filled state budgets, but also encouraged smuggling and trade. Observing the salt in the relationship with geology, chemistry, mythology, medicine, various beliefs and beliefs, therefore, observing the salt and "salt" culture, which developed with metallurgy and salt mines, sea salt and trade, mineral techniques and ways of exploiting salt miners and various forms of use of salt, we told five salty stories and emphasize the importance and sweet substances without which life is unthinkable and impossible. It is enough to emphasize that in the human body with a mass of 70 kg of 15 liters of salty liquids. Scientists and experts from different fields participate in all stories. The first story is "The Substance Favorite to the Gods," followed by "Solnah Puts", "With the taste of the sea", "in the womb of the earth" and "Salt of Life". R .: Miljenko Bukovčan ... / Sol života - (E01, dok. serija, Hrvatska, 2005) Sol je prirodni mineral i proizvod potreban za život čovjeka i stoke. Upotreba soli u suvremenom životu proširila se na razna područja u obrtu i industriji. Danas je teško zamisliti što je sve u prošlosti sol značila. Ona je bila dragocjen proizvod koji je određivao tržište kao što ga danas određuje potrošnja nafte. Njezina proizvodnja bila je ograničena i nadgledala se, jer je gotovo svuda bila državni monopol. Taj monopol punio je državne proračune, ali i poticao krijumčarenje i trgovinu. Promatrajući sol u odnosu spram geologije, kemije, mitologije, medicine, raznih vjerovanja i uvjerenja, dakle, promatrajući sol i "solne" kulture, koje su se razvile uz metalurgiju i rudnike soli, morske solane i trgovinu, tehnike rudarenja i načine iskorištavanja rudnika soli te razne oblike uporabe soli, ispričali smo pet slanih priča želeći približiti i naglasiti važnost te slane, ali u njezinu nedostatku i slatke tvari bez koje je život nezamisliv i nemoguć. Dovoljno je samo naglasiti da je u ljudskom tijelu s masom od 70 kg 15 litara slanih tekućina. U svim pričama sudjeluju znanstvenici i stručnjaci s različitih područja. Prva je priča "Tvar omiljela bogovima", a slijede "Solni putevi", "S okusom mora", "U utrobi Zemlje" i "Sol života". R.: Miljenko Bukovčan...

The use of salt in modern life has spread to various areas in the craft and industry. Today, it's hard to imagine what Salt has meant in the past. This monopoly filled state budgets, but also encouraged smuggling and trade. It is enough to emphasize that in the human body with a mass of 70 kg of 15 liters of salty liquids. Scientists and experts from different fields participate in all stories. The first story is "The Substance Favorite to the Gods," followed by "Solnah Puts", "With the taste of the sea", "in the womb of the earth" and "Salt of Life". Ona je bila dragocjen proizvod koji je određivao tržište kao što ga danas određuje potrošnja nafte. Njezina proizvodnja bila je ograničena i nadgledala se, jer je gotovo svuda bila državni monopol. Taj monopol punio je državne proračune, ali i poticao krijumčarenje i trgovinu. Dovoljno je samo naglasiti da je u ljudskom tijelu s masom od 70 kg 15 litara slanih tekućina. U svim pričama sudjeluju znanstvenici i stručnjaci s različitih područja. Prva je priča "Tvar omiljela bogovima", a slijede "Solni putevi", "S okusom mora", "U utrobi Zemlje" i "Sol života". R.: Miljenko Bukovčan...

programme.title: Blagoje Bersa: Flower, Concert performance of Opera - KD V. Lisinski / Blagoje Bersa: Oganj, koncertna izvedba opere - KD V. Lisinski
programme.desc: Blagoje Bersa: Oganj, Concert performance of Opera - KD V. Lisinski - (Show Magazine, Croatia, 2024) The cooperation of the Croatian Radio and Television, the Croatian National Theater in Zagreb and the Vatroslav Lisinski Concert Hall in the Canconyer cycle, on January 18, 2024. Berse. The concert performance on the occasion of the 150th anniversary of the birth and 90th anniversary of the death of the composer was attended by soloists, champions of Zagreb opera-Valentina Fijacko Kobić, Stjepan Franevović, Ljubomir Puškarić, Luciano Batinić, Siniša Stork and Siniša Hapač, and the Choir and Symphony Orchestra of HRT, HRT. The performance was led by Maestro Aleksandar Markovic. Blagoje Bersa is one of the most influential Croatian composers and musical educators whose musical oeuvre and action have significantly characterized the Croatian music of the period of modern and the first half of the 20th century. Born in Dubrovnik, educated in Vienna, Zagreb, Trieste and Zadar, Opera Oganj began to compose in 1905 in Zadar and completed it in 1906 in Vienna. Although Bersa sought to be premiered in Vienna, this did not happen, so the original German libretto of Alfred Marie Willner, with the title Der Eisenhammer, translated Ferdo Zivko Miller into Croatian by leaning. It was first staged on January 12, 1911 at the Croatian National Theater in Zagreb, and the Zagreb audience, as well as criticism, welcomed the performance with enthusiasm. Antun Gustav Matos called the fire "The first artistic opera of the high and modern style created by a Croat," especially praising "the brilliant orchestral part", Josip Andric said "standing worthy among the works that European music received them in the time of a quarter of a century ago", and Lujo Saffranek-Kavic called Bersa "inspired by Bersa who is a perfect manner who the apparatus. " The opera was performed only in 2003 at the Croatian National Theater in Zagreb. This concert performance on the occasion of the 150th anniversary of his ... / Blagoje Bersa: Oganj, koncertna izvedba opere - KD V. Lisinski - (show magazin, Hrvatska, 2024) Suradnja Hrvatske radiotelevizije, Hrvatskog narodnog kazališta u Zagrebu i Koncertne dvorane Vatroslava Lisinskog u ciklusu Kanconijer, 18. siječnja 2024. iznjedrila je prvu integralnu izvedbu jednog od kapitalnih djela hrvatske glazbe 20. stoljeća - operu Oganj Blagoja Berse. U koncertnoj izvedbi u povodu 150. godišnjice rođenja i 90. godišnjice smrti skladatelja sudjelovali su solisti, prvaci zagrebačke Opere - Valentina Fijačko Kobić, Stjepan Franetović, Ljubomir Puškarić, Luciano Batinić, Siniša Štork i Siniša Hapač, te Zbor i Simfonijski orkestar HRT-a, Zbor HNK-a Zagreb i Dječji zbor HRT-a. Izvedbu je predvodio maestro Aleksandar Marković. Blagoje Bersa jedan je od najutjecajnijih hrvatskih skladatelja i glazbenih pedagoga čiji su glazbeni opus i djelovanje bitno obilježili hrvatsku glazbu razdoblja moderne i prve polovice 20. stoljeća. Rođen u Dubrovniku, školovan u Beču, Zagrebu, Trstu i Zadru, operu Oganj počeo je skladati 1905. u Zadru i dovršio je 1906. u Beču. Iako je Bersa nastojao da se djelo praizvede u Beču, to se nije dogodilo, stoga je i izvorni njemački libreto Alfreda Marie Willnera, s naslovom Der Eisenhammer, na hrvatski preveo Ferdo Živko Miler naslovivši djelo Oganj. Prvi je put uprizorena 12. siječnja 1911. godine u Hrvatskome narodnom kazalištu u Zagrebu, a zagrebačka publika, kao i kritika, izvedbu je dočekala s oduševljenjem. Antun Gustav Matoš nazvao je Oganj "prvom umjetničkom operom visokog i modernog stila koju stvori Hrvat", osobito hvaleći "briljantni orkestralni dio", Josip Andrić ocijenio je da "stoji dostojno među djelima što ih je europska glazba dobila u doba prije četvrt stoljeća", a Lujo Šafranek-Kavić nazvao je Bersu "inspiriranim majstorom koji savršeno vlada čitavim aparatom". Opera je na izvorniku (pra)izvedena tek 2003. godine u Hrvatskom narodnom kazalištu u Zagrebu. Ova koncertna izvedba u povodu 150. obljetnice njegova ...

programme.title: On the edge of science / Na rubu znanosti
programme.desc: At the edge of science - (known. Pop. Series, Croatia, 2025) Although the term is an extracurricular experience of a recent date and dates from the 1960s, the content of that term itself is much older. Ever since the images of Egyptian times, the separation of a man's soul from his body is displayed, with which he still remains connected. It happens every night, but the man is unconscious. But what if she learns to be aware of that? Then the adventures outside the body begin, once called astral travel. Today, they are called extracurricular experiences, and they throw a completely different picture of the nature of the world and man. For more than half a century, there have been techniques that can be learned by the people with extracurricular experiences ... / Na rubu znanosti - (znan. pop. serija, Hrvatska, 2025) Mada je pojam izvantjelesno iskustvo novijeg datuma i potječe iz šezdesetih godina 20. stoljeća, sam sadržaj tog pojma puno je stariji. Još od slika iz egipatskih vremena prikazuje se odvajanje čovjekove duše od njegova tijela, s kojim ipak ostaje povezana. To se zbiva svake noći, ali čovjek je toga nesvjestan. No, što ako nauči biti toga svjestan? Tada počinju avanture izvan tijela, nekad zvane astralnim putovanjima. Danas ih se zove izvantjelesnim iskustvima, a ona bacaju posve drugu sliku na prirodu svijeta i čovjeka. Već više od pola stoljeća postoje i tehnike kojima se čovjek može naučiti izvantjelesnim iskustvima...

programme.title: 18. Scream - Rijeka Book Fair and Authors Festival - Chronicle / 18. Vrisak - riječki sajam knjiga i festival autora - Kronika
programme.desc: 18. Scream - Rijeka Book Fair and Festival Authors - Chronicle - (E01, Artistic Program, Croatia, 2025) This year's scream, in its adult 18th edition, is held from 13 to 20 September 2025. At seven Rijeka locations, with more than 50 literary and cultural events and participation of more than a hundred authors, artists and guests. This year's festival re -gathers prominent names of the domestic, regional and world literary scene. Among the foreign guests are the Italian writer and winner of the "Straga" Award Veronica Raimo, internationally recognized American author Alexander Hemon, who is also known to the wider audience as one of the screenwriters of the cult film Matrix, Norwegian literary star Oliver Lovren, British author Eleanor Shearr and Palestinian -American writer Etaf Rum. As every year, many authors from Croatia and the region will be joined by foreign guests. Follow conversations with authors in our chronicles ... / 18. Vrisak - riječki sajam knjiga i festival autora - Kronika - (E01, umjetnički program, Hrvatska, 2025) Ovogodišnji Vrisak, u svom punoljetnom 18. izdanju, održava se od 13. do 20. rujna 2025. na sedam riječkih lokacija, uz više od 50 književnih i kulturnih događanja i sudjelovanje više od sto autora, umjetnika i gostiju iz Hrvatske i svijeta. Ovogodišnji festival ponovno okuplja istaknuta imena domaće, regionalne i svjetske književne scene. Među stranim su gostima talijanska književnica i dobitnica nagrade "Strega" Veronica Raimo, međunarodno priznati američkobosanski autor Aleksandar Hemon, koji je široj publici poznat i kao jedan od scenarista kultnog filma Matrix, norveška književna zvijezda Oliver Lovrenski, britanska autorica Eleanor Shearer i palestinskoamerička spisateljica Etaf Rum. Inozemnim gostima će se kao i svake godine pridružiti i mnoge autorice i autori iz Hrvatske i regije. Razgovore s autorima pratite u našim kronikama...

programme.title: Charles: King and Man / Charles: kralj i čovjek
programme.desc: Charles, The Monarch and the Man - (Doc. Film, England, 2022) prominent radio and television presenter and writer Jonathan Dimbleby, author of the prince of Prince of Wales, considers the achievements of the man who is now the king. Since the publication of his birth onwards, Charles lived in front of cameras and television cameras. This show reaches for these rich archives of touching shots showing Prince's search for his role and suggest what the monarch will be ... / Charles, The Monarch and the Man - (dok. film, Engleska, 2022) Istaknuti radijski i televizijski voditelj i pisac Jonathan Dimbleby, autor biografije Princa od Walesa, razmatra postignuća čovjeka koji je sada kralj. Od objave njegova rođenja pa nadalje, Charles je živio pred fotoaparatima i televizijskim kamerama. Ova emisija poseže za tim bogatim arhivom dirljivih snimki koje prikazuju Prinčevo traganje za njegovom ulogom i sugeriraju kakav će monarh biti...

programme.title: Retrospective Alain Delon: A dangerous profession / Retrospektiva Alaina Delona: Opasna profesija
programme.desc: Flic Story - (Crimea Film, France, 1975) Inspector Borniche (Alain Delon) seeks for a dangerous psychopath Buisson (Jean -Louis Trintignant), runaway from a psychiatric hospital. The search will take three years, and Psychopath Buisson will find, in his disturbed way, some kind of common language with Borniche and police. R .: Jacques Deray Ul.: Alain Delon (Roger Borniche), Jean-Louis Trintignant (Emile Buisson), Renato Salvatori (Mario Poncini Dit Le Rital), Claudine Auger (Catherine), Andre Pousse (Jean-Baptiste Buisson) ... / Flic Story - (krim. film, Francuska, 1975) Inspektor Borniche (Alain Delon) traga za opasnim psihopatom Buissonom (Jean-Louis Trintignant), odbjeglim iz psihijatrijske bolnice. Potraga će potrajati tri godine, a psihopat Buisson naći će, na svoj poremećen način, neku vrstu zajedničkog jezika s Bornicheom i policijom. R.: Jacques Deray Ul.: Alain Delon (Roger Borniche), Jean-Louis Trintignant (Emile Buisson), Renato Salvatori (Mario Poncini dit Le Rital), Claudine Auger (Catherine), Andre Pousse (Jean-Baptiste Buisson)...

programme.title: Chosen / Izabrani
programme.desc: The Chosen - (S03, E01, a feature series, USA, 2022) Jesus held the most important sermon in history. What was the result? More followers, more enemies and students who are willing to follow him to the end of the world. Simon and Eden are together again, Matthew must face her past, Andrew visits John the Baptist in prison. Jesus has problems with the Romans. Tensions grow after pilgrims from all over and start setting tents at the entrance to the cafearum to see Jesus. Jesus officially sends 12 apostles to an exciting but dangerous mission. Little Jacob will wonder why not healed. R .: Dallas Jenkins Ul.: Jonathan Roumie (Jesus), Shahar Isaac (Simon Peter), Elizabeth Tabish (Mary Magdalene), Paras Patel (Matthew), Noah James (Andrew) ... / The Chosen - (S03, E01, igrana serija, SAD, 2022) Isus je održao najvažniju propovijed u povijesti. Kakav je bio rezultat toga? Više sljedbenika, više neprijatelja i učenici koji su ga spremni slijediti na kraj svijeta. Šimun i Eden ponovno su zajedno, Matej se mora suočiti sa svojom prošlošću, Andrija posjećuje Ivana Krstitelja u zatvoru. Isus ima problema s Rimljanima. Napetosti rastu nakon što pristignu hodočasnici iz svih krajeva i počnu postavljati šatore na ulazu u Kafarnaum kako bi vidjeli Isusa. Isus službeno šalje 12 apostola u uzbudljivu, ali opasnu misiju. Mali Jakov zapitat će se zašto nije izliječen. R.: Dallas Jenkins Ul.: Jonathan Roumie (Jesus), Shahar Isaac (Simon Peter), Elizabeth Tabish (Mary Magdalene), Paras Patel (Matthew), Noah James (Andrew)...

programme.title: Garage / Garaža
programme.desc: Garage - (music. Show, Croatia, 2009) in the garage Franko Krajcar with the first author's album Pensieri (tal. Thoughts, thoughts, memories, memories) in an original way, presents its sowing ethno -amental story. The album is a blend of electronics and ambience, in which Krajcar represents a songwriter song, with two covers of traditional songs and one instrumental processing. Because it is used with more instruments (which classic and traditional), most of the songs from the album has played itself. In the song "Melankonia", his guest is Jadranka Stojakovic, a songwriter from Sarajevo, who lives and creates today in Japan. In the song "Going Janja", his father, Zlatko Krajcar Minja, joined him. For the garage Franko Krajcar, he performed the following songs: Tanac, native Gruda, melanchony, went to Janja, Dojninolej and Pensieri ... / Garaža - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2009) U Garaži Franko Krajcar prvim autorskim albumom Pensieri (tal. misli, razmišljanja, uspomene, sjećanja) na originalan način predstavlja svoju sjetnu etno-ambijentalnu priču. Album je spoj elektronike i ambijenta, u kojem Krajcar predstavlja kantautorske pjesme, uz dvije obrade tradicionalnih pjesama te jednu instrumentalnu obradu. Budući da se koristi većim brojem instrumenata (što klasičnih, što tradicionalnih), veći dio pjesama iz albuma je i odsvirao sam. U pjesmi "Melankonija" gošća mu je Jadranka Stojaković, kantautorica iz Sarajeva, koja danas živi i stvara u Japanu. U pjesmi "Pošla Janja" pridružio mu se otac, Zlatko Krajcar Minji. Za Garažu Franko Krajcar izveo je sljedeće pjesme: Tanac, Rodna gruda, Melankonija, Pošla Janja, Dojninolej i Pensieri...

programme.desc: Innocence - (Drama, Australia, 2000) after they were separated for over forty years, Andreas and Claire are embarking on a love affair just as reckless and intense as when they were young. Musician and widower Andreas decides to get in touch with his only great love of Claire, who is still married to her first husband John. Andreas and Claire reveal that the love they felt while they were young and still exists and soon re -embark on the love affair of flared passions. R.: Paul Cox Ul.: Julia Blake (Claire), Terry Norris (John), Robert Menzies (David), Marta Dusseldorp (Monique), Kenny Aernouts (Young Andreas) ... / Innocence - (drama, Australija, 2000) Nakon što su bili razdvojeni više od četrdeset godina, Andreas i Claire upuštaju se u ljubavnu vezu jednako nepromišljenu i intenzivnu kao kad su bili mladi. Glazbenik i udovac Andreas odluči stupiti u kontakt sa svojom jedinom velikom ljubavi Claire, koja je još u braku sa svojim prvim mužem Johnom. Andreas i Claire otkrivaju da ljubav koju su osjećali dok su bili mladi i dalje postoji te se ubrzo ponovno upuštaju u ljubavnu vezu rasplamsanih strasti. programme.desc: Salt of Life - (E02, Doc. Series, Croatia, 2005) "There are no more useful from the sun and salt of all bodies," Pliny older in his natural encyclopedia "Historia Naturalis". Many nations have taken over this realization, welcoming friends and acquaintances, manifesting faithfulness and hospitality. It is therefore a cultural and material good. The evidence of exploitation and use, from the oldest times in different parts of the world and its meaning in the creation of cultures, will speak prof. Marina Miličević and prof. Dr. Alexander Durman. Add a grain of salt, or as Pliny says "Addito Salis Grano", the instruction is in the fight against any poison. Ovu su spoznaju mnogi narodi preuzeli iskazujući dobrodošlicu prijateljima i znancima, očitujući vjernost i gostoprimstvo. Ona je dakle kulturno i materijalno dobro. O dokazima iskorištavanja i uporabe, od najstarijih vremena u različitim dijelovima svijeta i njezinu značenju u stvaranju kultura, govorit će prof. dr. Marina Miličević i prof. dr. Aleksandar Durman. Dodati zrno soli, ili kako to Plinije kaže "Addito salis grano", naputak je u borbi protiv svakog otrova. R.: Miljenko Bukovčan...

programme.title: Romano Bolkovic - 1 on 1 / Romano Bolković - 1 na 1
programme.desc: Romano Bolković - 1 to 1 - (Talk Show, Croatia, 2025) Prof. Dr. Miro Jakovljevic, physician psychiatrist, professor emeritus at the University of Zagreb, subspecialist of biological psychiatry and social psychiatry. We discuss with Professor Jakovljevic about the definition of the health and culture of the soul, the health of the well -being and satisfaction of our needs, the components of health, the salutogenesis, the construction of healthy society and empathy civilization, about toxic cultures and a sense of security, and paranoid culture, radicalization and manic, narcissistic culture in which we live and the transgenerational culture and the transgenequent culture and the transgenequent culture in which we live and the transgenequent culture and the transgenequent culture, in which we live and the transgenequent culture and the transgenequent culture, and the transgenequent culture and the transgenequent culture in which we live and the transgenequent culture and the transgenequent culture and the transgenequent culture in which we live and transgend Traumas, about depressed culture and a healthy individual in a toxic society, on the foam attacks on citizens around the world and in us, cult of happiness, false and authentic happiness, about the anomity of our society and the democratic right to be a fool, about Rifkin's concept of a race for global consciousness, what is the basis of Western civilizations. Prof. Dr. Miro Jakovljevic, Professor Emeritus, was the head of the Clinic for Psychiatry of the Faculty of Medicine, University of Zagreb at KBC Zagreb from 2007 to 2015, Head of the Department of Psychiatry of the Faculty of Medicine, University of Mostar from 2000 to 2013 and Vice -Dean of Science, Faculty of Medicine, University of Mostar from 2007. He has published 20 books, more than 28 chapters in the books of other authors and more than 200 scientific and professional papers. He was a leader and chief researcher in numerous national and international clinical research. The invited lecturer at numerous national, international and world congresses. The most mentioned is a psychiatrist in the region and is located on the Stanford list of 2% of distinguished world scientists in Croatia. He is the editor -in -chief of the magazine "Psychiatria Danubina" and the magazine "Medicine Academica Integrative". R .: Tvrtko Grgić ... / Romano Bolković - 1 na 1 - (talk show, Hrvatska, 2025) Prof. dr. Miro Jakovljević, liječnik psihijatar, professor emeritus na Sveučilištu u Zagrebu, subspecijalist biologijske psihijatrije i socijalne psihijatrije. S profesorom Jakovljevićem razgovaramo o definiciji zdravlja i kulturi duše, o zdravlju kao blagostanju i zadovoljavanju naših potreba, o komponentama zdravlja, o salutogenezi, o izgradnji zdravog društva i empatijske civilizacije, o toksičnim kulturama i osjećaju sigurnosti te paranoidnoj kulturi, o radikalizaciji i maničnoj, narcističkoj kulturi u kojoj živimo te o transgeneracijskim traumama, o depresivnoj kulturi i zdravom pojedincu u toksičnom društvu, o sumanutim napadima na građane diljem svijeta i u nas, kultu sreće, lažnoj i autentičnoj sreći, o anomičnosti našeg društva i demokratskom pravu da se bude budala, o Rifkinovom konceptu utrke za globalnom sviješću, o tome što je temelj zapadne civilizacije empatije te o sukobu civilizacija. Prof. dr. Miro Jakovljević, professor emeritus, bio je predstojnik Klinike za psihijatriju Medicinskog fakulteta Sveučilišta u Zagrebu u KBC Zagreb od 2007. do 2015., pročelnik Katedre za psihijatriju Medicinskog fakulteta Sveučilišta u Mostaru od 2000. do 2013. te prodekan za znanost Medicinskog fakulteta Sveučilišta u Mostaru od 2007. do 2013. godine. Objavio je 20 knjiga, više od 28 poglavlja u knjigama drugih autora te više od 200 znanstvenih i stručnih radova. Bio je voditelj i glavni istraživač u brojnim nacionalnim i internacionalnim kliničkim istraživanjima. Pozvani predavač na brojnim nacionalnim, internacionalnim i svjetskim kongresima. Najcitiraniji je psihijatar u regiji i nalazi se na Stanford listi 2% uglednih svjetskih znanstvenika u Hrvatskoj. Glavni je urednik časopisa "Psychiatria Danubina" i časopisa "Medicina Academica Integrativa". R.: Tvrtko Grgić...

programme.desc: Studio 4: Diagnosis - (Show Magazine, Croatia, 2025) Miastenija Gravis. What do we need to know about this diagnosis? Why do we call her a snowflake disease? This neuromuscular disease is characterized by occasional muscle weaknesses, which worsen during the activity and calm down after rest. We discuss contemporary diagnosis and treatment with prof. Ph.D. Ervin Bilić, MD, head of the Clinic of Neurology, KBC Zagreb. Editor and presenter: Sanja Kocijancic Petricevic ... / Studio 4: Dijagnoza - (show magazin, Hrvatska, 2025) Miastenija gravis. Što trebamo znati o ovoj dijagnozi? Zašto je zovemo bolest pahuljica? Ovu neuromuskularnu bolest karakteriziraju povremene slabosti mišića, koje se pogoršavaju tijekom aktivnosti, a smiruju nakon odmora. O suvremenoj dijagnostici i liječenju razgovaramo s prof. dr. sc. Ervinom Bilić, dr. med., predstojnicom Klinike za neurologiju, KBC Zagreb. Urednica i voditeljica: Sanja Kocijančić Petričević...

programme.title: The Hitmans Bodyguard / The Hitmans Bodyguard
programme.desc: The film revolves around the best personal guard in the world, who is assigned to guard a professional killer, as this killer is required to testify before the International Court of Justice, and here the two must step down their dispute aside, and work together to reach the court on time. / تدور احداث الفيلم حول أفضل حارس شخصي في العالم، والذي يتم تكليفه بحراسة قاتل محترف، حيث أن هذا القاتل مطلوب للإدلاء بشهادته أمام محكمة العدل الدولية، وهنا يجب على الاثنين أن ينحيا خلافتهما جانبًا، وأن يعملا معًا من أجل الوصول إلى المحكمة في الوقت المحدد.

programme.title: xXx / xXx
programme.desc: After another operation to eliminate this group called Anarki 99, which includes a group of former Russian soldiers, the national security agent August Gibbons (Samuel L. Jackson) is searching for an unconventional agent to implement his goals. Gibbons finds his misfortune in Zandrakeg (Van Diesel), a former athlete known for his reckless behavior, and his law, and Gibbons assigns him a very dangerous mission related to that organization that aims to destroy the world. Events escalate and complicate things in an atmosphere of excitement and deadly risk. / بعد أن فشلت عملية أخرى للقضاء على تلك المجموعة المسماة أناركي 99 والتي تضم مجموعة من الجنود الروس السابقين، يقوم عميل الأمن الوطني أوجستس جيبونز (صامويل ل. جاكسون) بالبحث عن عميلٍ غير تقليدي لينفذ أهدافه. يجد جيبونز ضالته في زاندركيج (فان ديزل) وهو رياضي سابق معروف بسلوكه المتهور واستهتاره بالقانون، ويكلفه جيبونز بمهمة شديدة الخطورة تتعلق بتلك المنظمة التي تهدف لتدمير العالم. تتصاعد الأحداث وتتعقد الأمور وسط أجواءٍ من الإثارة والخطورة المميتة.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 2 / The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 2
programme.desc: After the recent events in the first part of (Mockingjay), and after Katnis Everdin (Jennifer Lawrence) became the symbol of the revolution in the face of the tyrannical Capitol regime, and with the return of Beta Melk (Josh Hatson) to his companions, Katnis interfered with her revolutionaries in a closing battle that will be the most difficult against the Capitol and President (Snow). / بعد الأحداث الأخيرة في الجزء الأول من (Mockingjay)، وبعد أن صارت كاتنيس إيفردين (جينيفر لورانس) هي رمز الثورة في مواجهة نظام الكابيتول المستبد، ومع عودة بيتا ملارك (جوش هاتشرسون) إلى رفاقه، تدخل كاتنيس مع رفاقها الثوار في معركة ختامية ستكون هي الأصعب على اﻹطلاق ضد الكابيتول والرئيس (سنو).

programme.title: Bride Wars / Bride Wars
programme.desc: Two girlfriends close to childhood turning into two enemies because of their wedding parties coinciding on the same day, and each of them refuses to postpone the ceremony, so does the friendship stand in front of every girl's dream of her wedding day? / صديقتان مقربتان من فترة الطفولة تتحولان لعدوتان بسبب تزامن حفلات زفافهن في نفس اليوم، وكل واحدة منهما ترفض تأجيل الحفل، فهل الصداقة تصمد أمام حلم كل فتاة بيوم زفافها؟

programme.title: What Happens in Vegas / What Happens in Vegas
programme.desc: A young man fond of gambling and a girl shocking in her boyfriend who leaves her on the night of his birthday, each one decides separately to travel to Las Vegas, and because of a computer line the same room is reserved for the hero and the girl, and they are located together a series of crazy events. / شاب مولع بالقمار وفتاة تصدم في حبيبها الذي يتركها في ليلة عيد ميلاده، يقرر كل واحد على حدة السفر إلى لاس فيجاس، وبسبب خطاً في الحاسوب يتم حجز نفس الغرفة للبطل والبنت، ويخوضان معًا سلسلة من اﻷحداث المجنونة.

programme.title: Blended / Blended
programme.desc: Lauren (Drew Barry Moore) or a single mother who is preparing an arranged date with Jim (Adam Sandlaler), but the appointment ends badly, and they agree on one thing that they will not meet again. The agreement changes when they find themselves forced to share one wing in a resort in Africa. Sigads occur between Lauren and Jim all the time, as well as the problems that arise between their children, but that relationship quickly develops for friendship and admiration. / لورين (درو باري مور) أم عزباء تحضر موعدًا مُدبرًا مع جيم (آدم ساندلير)، لكن الموعد ينتهي بشكل سيء، ويتفقان على شيء واحد وهو أنهما لن يتقابلا مرة أخرى. يتبدل الاتفاق عندما يجدان أنفسهما مضطرين لمشاركة جناح واحد في أحد المنتجعات في أفريقيا. تباعًا تحدث مشاكسات بين لورين وجيم طوال الوقت، بالإضافة إلى المشاكل التي تنشأ بين أطفالهما، لكن سرعان ما تتطور تلك العلاقة لصداقة ثم إعجاب.

programme.title: 3 Days to Kill / 3 Days to Kill
programme.desc: Ethan Ranner (Kevin Costner) is an international spy who decides to leave his risky life in order to build a strong relationship with his daughter and wife. Ethan has been far from his daughter and his wife to protect them from the dangers surrounding him from every side, but Ethan should complete a last task before retiring, which is the harm to the most dangerous terrorist in the world, in addition to the most difficult task, which is to take care of his daughter for the first time in ten years as his wife is outside the town. / إيثان رانر (كيفين كوستنر) جاسوسٌ دولي يقرر ترك حياته المليئة بالمخاطر من أجل بناء علاقةٍ قويةٍ مع ابنته وزوجته. ظل إيثان بعيدًا عن ابنته وزوجته من أجل حمايتهما من المخاطر المحيطة به من كل جانب، ولكن يتعين على إيثان استكمال مهمة أخيرة قبل أن يعتزل وهي النيل من أخطر إرهابي على مستوى العالم، بالإضافة لمهمة أصعب وهي الاعتناء بابنته لأول مرة منذ عشرة أعوام حيث إن زوجته خارج البلدة.

programme.title: Trigger Point / Trigger Point
programme.desc: In the context of the movement, the work deals with the story of the retired American private agent Nicholas Show, who spends his life after retiring to work for the secret elite team with the aim of eliminating the worst bad guys all over the world. / في إطار من الحركة، يتناول العمل قصة العميل الأمريكي الخاص المتقاعد نيكولاس شو، والذي يقضي حياته بعد التقاعد بالعمل لحساب فريق النخبة السري بهدف القضاء على أسوأ الأشرار في جميع أنحاء العالم.

programme.title: RED 2 / RED 2
programme.desc: The second part of the comedy movement that achieved great success in 2010. The story follows the retired CIA intelligence agent, Frank Mosiz, who meets again with his unconventional team of retired clients in turn, to track and nullify a missing nuclear bomber that may cause a disaster. For success in the task, the team will have to overcome a professional killers: terrorists, and corrupt government employees, who in turn seek to reach the dangerous weapon. The task pushes Moses and his team to travel to Paris, London, and Moscow, unarmed or ready, and they will have to rely on each other and their old talents to survive and save the world. / الجزء الثاني من فيلم الحركة الكوميدي الذي حقق نجاحًا كبيرًا عام 2010. تتبع القصة عميل مخابرات الـ CIA المتقاعد فرانك موسز الذي يجتمع مرة أخرى بفريقه غير التقليدي من العملاء المتقاعدين بدورهم، وهذا لتعقب وإبطال مفجر نووي مفقود قد يسبب كارثة. وللنجاح في المهمة سيكون على الفريق أن يتخطى جيشًا من القتلة المحترفين: إرهابيين، وموظفين حكوميين فاسدين، الذين يسعون بدورهم إلى الوصول إلى السلاح الخطير. المهمة تدفع موسز وفريقه على السفر إلى باريس، ولندن، وموسكو، غير مسلحين ولا مستعدين، وسيكون عليهم الاعتماد على بعضهم البعض وعلى مواهبهم القديمة للنجاة وإنقاذ العالم.

programme.title: Limitless / Limitless
programme.desc: Eddy Mora is an author and author of an unemployed, who is undergoing new drug experiences under testing with the help of one of his old friends, when he is subject to the test of one of the drugs that enhance the use of mental forces, Idi is surprised that making him more confident, focused and memory; So Eddy's life rises quickly to the world of success. Karl Van Von discovers this secret, chasing Edi to obtain this medicine, and tries to get rid of it. / إيدى مورا مؤلف وكاتب عاطل عن العمل، يخضع لتجارب العقاقير الجديدة قيد الاختبار بمساعدة أحد أصدقائه القدامى، حينما يخضع لاختبار أحد الأدوية التي تعزز استخدام القوى العقلية، يفاجئ إيدى بأن جعله أكثر ثقة وتركيزا وذاكرة؛ لذا ترتقي حياة إيدي بسرعة لعالم النجاح، يكتشف كارل فان فون هذا السر، فيطارد إيدى من أجل الحصول على هذا الدواء، ويحاول التخلص منه.

programme.title: Doctor Sleep / Doctor Sleep
programme.desc: After years of (The Shining), Dan Torringi tries to stand in front of a bloody and dangerous sectarian group, where she intentionally eliminates children with supernatural abilities, and when he meets a girl who carries strange capabilities, he decides to protect her, whatever the matter is costly. / بعد سنوات من أحداث (The Shining)، يحاول (دان تورينسي) الوقوف أمام جماعة طائفية دموية وخطيرة، حيث تتعمد القضاء على الأطفال الذين يحملون قدرات خارقة، وعندما يقابل فتاة تحمل قدرات غريبة، يقرر حمايتها مهما تكلف الأمر.

programme.desc: The series revolves around the seven -year -old girl Abe Hatcher and her friend Bouzli, who are fighting together many adventures every day in order to solve the problems of her hotel. / تدور أحداث المسلسل حول الفتاة الصغيرة البالغة من العمر سبع سنوات آبي هاتشر وصديقتها الصدوقة بوزلي واللذان يخوضان معًا العديد من المغامرات كل يوم في سبيل حل مشاكل فندقها.

programme.title: Hello Sesame program / برنامج أهلا سمسم
